title: Scoped obstruction: P111 query transport exceeds the frozen U8 host budget
body:
The P111 decoder's smaller local COPY cost does not by itself pay for delivery
of its changed query from the existing U8 gather rows. This adds a scoped
negative result for a query inserted after U8 section A, with the old rows,
later frame contracts, and helper widths fixed, and with no mixing between
new carriers before the query hyperplane.

Review files: [Proof and scope](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ed5424aa3b6ca32fd5bb2c33a8e6afcd87170160/research/shared-carrier-host/PROOF.md) · [Evidence](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ed5424aa3b6ca32fd5bb2c33a8e6afcd87170160/research/shared-carrier-host/RESULT.json) · [Source pins and credit](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ed5424aa3b6ca32fd5bb2c33a8e6afcd87170160/research/shared-carrier-host/SOURCES.json).

For all 112 punctures, exact rational elimination gives a unique expression
in the eligible old rows. Their required frames are pairwise incomparable and
cannot advance inside the query hyperplane while preserving the old tail.
The minimum transport profiles are `10 H5 + 6 H6`, `8 H5 + 10 H6`, or `26 H6`.

A favorable complete moment bound gives free entrance frames, no separate
centre charge, free compensation and interface work, and pooled fractional
rank-48 idle space. It credits each puncture's actual source and target paths,
plus the `H8 -> H7` COPY saving. Every case still exceeds one at historical
[PR #942](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/942) b; the minimum is enclosed by
`1.00000864736369386816835926810620863001514` and
`1.00000864736369386816835926935824150131476`.
A linear volume argument covers every positive replica count and mixtures of
punctures. This fixed-U8 class also fails at the larger b selected by
[PR #1042](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1042) at the recorded refresh. The proof does not apply to [PR #1042](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1042)'s word.

Reproduce with the standard library:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/shared-carrier-host/verify.py --out /tmp/shared-carrier-host-result.json
```

Expected: `PASS_SCOPED_FROZEN_U8_GATHER_OBSTRUCTION`. The command reconstructs
raw U8 from the pinned [PR #799](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/799) archive and U8 recipe. It checks all root/label
pairings, frame paths, unique row expressions, antichains, actual data-path
credits, and rational cost intervals. It compares power intervals against the
retained independent engine. Controls cover wrong query coefficients,
coalesced paths, old-row advances, and a mixed label chart. The free-query
control passes, so the transport charge is decisive.

Base: [abdc6a7002abdbcd9e21bfc5e1a795784deacfdf](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/commit/abdc6a7002abdbcd9e21bfc5e1a795784deacfdf). The [PR #1060](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1060) source head is
[d27499553138bde007f5b1163e65e71da1b18899](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/commit/d27499553138bde007f5b1163e65e71da1b18899). The reconstructed U8 raw hash is
`090fd574747fbf9628e70cb9beb792732914cfa52e1df147579fe4dbccc68c5a`.
Only [research/shared-carrier-host/](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/tree/ed5424aa3b6ca32fd5bb2c33a8e6afcd87170160/research/shared-carrier-host) is added. The selected frontier and
[upstream/](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/tree/ed5424aa3b6ca32fd5bb2c33a8e6afcd87170160/upstream) stay unchanged. This is a scoped negative result, not a new kappa
or a complete multiplication theorem. Changed A/B words, early mixing,
nonmonotone paths, and different owner geometry remain open.

The package records the initial direct-host failure, the endpoint escape,
and the reason for the row-reuse pivot. It credits [PR #717](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/717), [PR #968](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/968), [PR #1060](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1060), the
[PR #799](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/799), [PR #869](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/869), [PR #870](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/870) U8 lineage, [PR #858](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/858), [PR #890](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/890), and [PR #942](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/942). substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0; no independent human review
